documents.note: Embedded in the replacement wiki as <oembed url="https://youtu.be/7XuxrBK58Nk">; written in the canonical watch form because youtu.be is not a document host. Not fetched (offline).

notes: Option groups: Compatibility (X1/P1/A1/P2/X2, A1 mini) and Texture (Carbon Fiber, Diamond, Galaxy, Starry). The wiki confirms the four patterns ("Currently, four patterns are available for selection: diamond, starry, galaxy, and carbon fiber."). Each Compatibility value is a compat.statement row and each Texture value a part.surface_type row of its own scope; no texture has a size or other value of its own.

Sizes come from the plates wiki dimensions table by printer model; neither the store page nor the 3D Effect Sheet tab gives a size of its own. The two fixture-tool files of the replacement wiki ("X1 Series/P1 Series/A1", "For A1 mini users") agree with two plate sizes.

Construction is described only in prose: laser-made optical textures on a transfer film (plates wiki; the part.surface_treatment row, unverified) on a spring steel plate (replacement wiki, Step2: "Place the Sheet and the spring steel plate on the Fixture tool"; the part.material row, unverified). The film's material is not named; part.material is not listed as not_published because the steel base is stated.

Slicer setting, not a spec: "Please set the plate type to Smooth PEI/High Temp Plate" (wiki and store). Heatbed settings per filament on this plate (store: PLA 60~65℃, TPU 35~45℃) have no plate-type registry key (print_settings.bed_temp is filament-only); they are kept in the notes of the PLA and TPU recommended_with relations.

Caveats kept as notes only: the X1 series lidar calibration does not work properly on the reflective film (wiki; the store says to skip lidar calibration or calibrate with a regular plate); X1/X2/P2 users should disable build plate position detection (store variant notes, already written by the deterministic layer); keep the surface clean, hot water and detergent. The plates are consumables (part.life_cycle, unverified) with no published life figure.
Fixture-tool 3MF files on wiki.bambulab.com are not listed as documents: the document registry would classify a wiki-host link as kind "wiki", not "model_file".
No hex (not a filament), no in-the-box list (neither the store page nor the wiki publishes one).
